newsitem.title: USA: Chrysler boosts incentives on large vans.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler boosts incentives on large vans.

text.p: Chrysler Corp said Wednesday it increased cash incentives on two 1996-model variations of its full-size vans, effective immediately.
Chrysler said the cash rebate on the 1996 Dodge Ram Wagon was increased to $1,500 from $1,200, while the rebate on the 1996 Dodge Ram Van Conversion was raised to $2,000 from $1,600.

The changes are in effect through April 7, 1997, Chrysler said, adding that the incentive program also gives new vehicle buyers the option of reduced interest rates on financing in lieu of the cash allowances.
